description: This file defines constants, types, and functions related to connection error codes and recovery advice in a protocol module.

methods.name: resolveAuthConnectErrorDetailCode
methods.description: Resolves a string reason to a specific connection error detail code related to authentication.

methods.name: resolveDeviceAuthConnectErrorDetailCode
methods.description: Resolves a string reason to a specific device authentication error detail code.

methods.name: readConnectErrorDetailCode
methods.description: Extracts the error code string from an unknown details object.

methods.name: readConnectErrorRecoveryAdvice
methods.description: Reads and normalizes recovery advice information from an unknown details object.
